2026-10-27 release review: Add cited audio-course production and strengthen transferable learning and recording handoffs.

A fluent script can still leave essential evidence, demonstration details and teaching decisions unresolved until recording.

2026-10-27 release review: Connect learning objectives, source-backed scripts and verifiable media delivery beyond activity completion.

Adds instructor-content elicitation, evidence/how-to checks, purposeful iteration and readiness boundaries. Removes historical personal computer-use locators from the generic procedure, preserving them in the private originating project. Adds corpus coverage, preserved speech, visible qualifications, concise multi-source notes, end references, video glossary scope and actual export checks under the existing production owner.

2026-10-27 release review: Retain the MIT claudemy source from assafkip with its source inventory and inactive nested manifests/hooks. Add audio-course wrappers, provider/source guards, focused tests and transcript-evidence workflow. Revise curriculum, assessment, storyboarding, lesson/evaluation and production guidance to preserve underlying concepts, instructor input, runnable demonstrations and learner checks. Include specialist policy updates.

Compatibility: Additive conditional guidance in existing storyboarding and course-production owners; no new skill or runtime dependency.

2026-10-27 release review: Existing instructional owners remain. Retained source hooks are not registered; rendering/provider setup and source rights remain explicit. Script readiness, audio production, media QA and learner evidence are separate states.

Upgrade: Use the content pass for substantial recorded lessons or missing-detail feedback; reuse completed passes for settled work.

2026-10-27 release review: Refresh the package and use the conditional audio-lesson or transcript workflow when required. Configure selected providers separately and verify the actual exported audio/transcript/package.

Validation: Skill frontmatter validated; changed links resolved; source and installed bytes matched. Claude scenario review exercised missing material and preserved useful exploration. Human delivery improvement remains untested. Transcript update: changed skill valid, 13 existing tests pass, changed local links resolve and four independent simulated challenge cases pass; no learner outcome claim.

2026-10-27 release review: The release scope record and current public/canonical source differences were reviewed read-only for this note.
